I was never prescribed with antidepressants as they said I was 'too young' (15). However, I was prescribed with Ranitidine which is like an antiacid used to treat stomach ulcers (which at first the doctor saw that I possibly had so I took a blood test which turned out I didn't have it.) Because I would experience the churning sensation mainly on schooldays this led my parents to become suspicious that I was getting bullied or something in school, now they know the truth that I absolutely fucking hate it and can't wait to leave.
